final_message:
I implemented `parsePorts`, `normalizePorts`, and `countPorts` in `src/ports.ts` following the README. All 3 tests in `tests/ports.test.ts` pass with `npm test`.

The three functions share one parser that validates each item, sorts the ranges, and merges overlapping or touching ones. I also checked the README example `normalizePorts("80, 443,8080 - 8090,8091")` (gives `80,443,8080-8091`) and the error cases (empty items, non-digits, out-of-range ports, reversed ranges), and they behave as specified.

I couldn't run a TypeScript type check because `tsc` isn't installed locally and the npm registry returned 403. Node 24 runs the `.ts` files directly, so the tests still exercise the code.
